sources.note: Main company page. Describes Greenway as a single-platform ambulatory solution provider with 30+ years of experience. Lists five solution categories: Clinical, Financial, Patient Engagement, Analytics, Professional Services. Mentions AWS cloud infrastructure.

ONC certification and compliance page. Lists Real World Testing docs for 2022-2026, SVAP notices. Notably does not mention Intergy by name — focuses on Greenway-branded solutions. Lists product modules including EHR, PM, RCM, patient portal, telehealth, analytics.

Intergy product page. Describes cloud-based EHR/PM for ambulatory practices. Key details: 500+ customizable templates, EPCS, PDMP integration, health reminders/care gap tracking, 5,000 reportable fields in Practice Analytics, CommonWell integration. KLAS 2022 Most Improved award.
General EHR solutions page. Describes AI-driven tools, Clinical Assist, Document Manager, dental records. Emphasizes comprehensive integration of clinical, financial, and patient engagement tools.

Patient portal details. SMART-on-FHIR powered. Patients can view records, lab results, medications; send messages; schedule appointments; request refills; pay bills. VDT-compliant. Works with both Intergy and Prime Suite.

Care coordination page. Three services: Chronic Care Management (CCM) with health coaches, Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) with real-time device data, and automated revenue workflows for CCM/RPM billing.
Company overview. 1,000 employees, 10,000+ organizations, 55,000+ providers, 40+ specialties. Founded 1977 as Medical Manager. Revenue Services clients collected $854M in payments (2019 figure).

Press release about transforming both EHR platforms (Intergy and Prime Suite). Could not load full content (403 error) but search excerpt confirmed both are active, separate EHR platforms being developed in parallel.

Detailed pricing and feature overview. Pricing: $799-941/provider/month base. 90 reviews, 4/5 rating. 81% positive sentiment. Features: EHR, PM, billing/claims, scheduling, e-prescribing, population health, care plans. Integration partners: PatientPop, Clearwave, Ambra Health, CareTrack.

Intergy PM features: rules-based scheduling, insurance eligibility verification, claim scrubbing, patient photo/insurance card imaging, clinical alerts, multi-location support, mobile access. Specialties: cardiology, neurology, pediatrics.
Intergy Suite brochure (PDF). Could not extract text content — PDF was not parseable. February 2025 brochure.

Wikipedia article (403 error on fetch, but search results provided key facts). Company history: Medical Manager (1977) -> Sage Healthcare -> Vitera (Vista Equity, 2011, $320M) -> merged with Greenway Medical Technologies (2013, $644M) -> Greenway Health. Also acquired SuccessEHS in 2013.
Greenway Telehealth page. HIPAA-compliant, device-agnostic telehealth integrated with the EHR. Providers launch visits from within Intergy workflow.
